name: talaria-omp-auth
description: The omp auth bridge — Oh My Pi's own OAuth login and token refresh, exposed to the Rust api over loopback. Talaria holds the credentials; omp performs the flows.

scripts.//prepare: dist/ is gitignored but IS what runs (the api spawns dist/server.js). npm and bun both run `prepare` after an install here, so installing can never leave you without a dist — the same last line of defence mcp/ has.
